title: Daily Latent-heat-flux Prolongation at Three FLUXNET Sites
summary: Prolong daily 2015-2022 LE at three FLUXNET sites from historical tower labels and aligned ERA5-Land and MODIS predictors using a site-specific bias-corrected random forest.
evaluation: Evaluation checks formal output validity and proceeds strictly through 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, stopping at the first failed gate. The 0.4 and 0.6 gates require both expert-product agreement and independent-validation non-inferiority; the 0.8 and 1.0 gates then add robust independent-observation superiority. Private values, support, resampling, and thresholds are not disclosed.
referenceNotes: C is the three-site, 2015-2022 subset of the author Zenodo V1.0 prolonged daily LE product (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13853409), with only site/date selection and decimal formatting.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)
